the line: a contact as it runs (oiled well; the escapement dry at 1.5e-6) must keep its figure over a service interval, 3 years (the 1954 instruction: cleaned and oiled every three years), or it fails; under the TU's 10 years of service life, or poorly oiled under 3, it is reported (~~)
oiled, every contact lasts 2.3 years and more well oiled; the first to go, the balance staff's pivot end on its endstone, 0.2 poorly oiled and 0.0 once the oil has gone

the escapement, dry: the first to go, the gold spring's face under the discharge stone, lasts 15 years at 1.5e-6 (4.5 at 5e-6, 1.5 at 1.5e-5); an overhaul resets the banking to the window's middle, so its room is a service interval's, not the clock's life
